deposit_title: The gut microbiome and metabolites are altered and interrelated in patients with rheumatoid arthritis
Q3_evidence_quote: Twenty-six RA patients were recruited from Taizhou Hospital of Zhejiang Province from July to December 2020.
Q4_evidence_quote: Fecal samples were collected using sterile stool containers. Each sample was split into two tubes and stored at -80°C until subsequent processing.
notes: The primary recruitment has 26 cases and 26 matched controls (total 52). The additional validation cohort has 11 cases plus 11 controls, which should not be folded into the selected discovery assay. Splitting a collected fecal sample into two storage tubes does not establish two independently collected specimens or a participant-to-row mapping.

deposit_title: Contributions of the Microbiome-Derived Metabolome for Risk Assessment and Prognostication of Pancreatic Cancer
Q3_evidence_quote: The study included 173 pancreatic cancer cases that were diagnosed within 5 years of blood draw and 863 matched non-cases from 10 participating PLCO study centers (Table 1).
Q4_evidence_quote: All plasma samples were collected and processed according to a uniform, standardized protocol across the sites and patient groups.
notes: The S2M file is a review rather than an assay-specific original cohort report. The S3 paper describes PLCO cases/controls and a separate newly diagnosed cohort and does not unambiguously tie the enumerated subjects to the selected MTBLS7260 serum assay. The collection protocol describes processing, not whether each individual supplied exactly one analytical sample.

deposit_title: Identification of a discriminative metabolomic fingerprint of potential clinical relevance in saliva of patients with periodontitis using 1H nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy
Q3_evidence_quote: The metabolome of stimulated saliva of 26 patients with generalized periodontitis (18 chronic and 8 aggressive) was compared to that of 25 healthy controls.
Q4_evidence_quote: The collection of saliva was done under standardized conditions, between 09:00 and 11:00 am after paraffin wax-stimulation
notes: The deposited investigation describes 26 cases and 25 controls for the comparison (51), while the paper Methods says 26 controls were recruited (52 enrolled); the 51 is supported by deposit description only and must not be treated as independently publication-confirmed. A specified saliva collection procedure does not explicitly establish one sample per participant.

deposit_title: Fecal Metabolomics and Potential Biomarkers for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus

notes: The paper describes the cohort and LC-MS processing of its fecal samples (32+26=58). It does not say one fecal specimen per individual, nor provide a distinct-identifier mapping.

deposit_title: Multi-omic Molecular Characterization and Diagnostic Biomarkers for Occult Hepatitis B Infection and HBsAg-Positive Hepatitis B Infection
Q3_evidence_quote: In the discovery cohorts, a total of 50 samples were collected, including 20 samples with occult HBV infection (OBI), 20 samples from HBsAg positive HBV infection, and 10 samples from healthy controls.
Q4_evidence_quote: These samples were collected from participants who were enrolled at Wuxi Red Cross Blood Center and Wuxi People’s Hospital between November 2017 and December 2023.
notes: The publication states 50 discovery samples and 289 validation samples, not distinct participant counts. deposit_title: Altered metabolome and microbiome features provide clues in understanding irritable bowel syndrome and depression comorbidity
Q3_evidence_quote: In total, we recruited 330 and 101 individuals for discovery and validation cohorts, respectively.
Q4_evidence_quote: Included subjects were instructed to provide morning first stool samples and fasting blood samples on the same day for biochemical detection and omics analyses.
notes: The publication distinguishes 330 discovery and 101 validation participants and enumerates fecal versus paired serum specimens. The packet does not uniquely designate whether the selected deposited fecal assay contains one or both cohort subsets; hence the study-wide participant counts should not be interpreted as a verified selected-assay count. Morning stool collection is described but does not explicitly rule out additional specimens.

deposit_title: Microbiome and metabolome patterns centered on cancer cachexia link skeletal muscle and adipose tissue depletion to clinical outcomes in locally advanced rectal cancer
Q3_evidence_quote: Blood samples for untargeted metabolomics were collected from 154 patients, with 134 retained after exclusions.
Q4_evidence_quote: fecal and blood samples were strictly collected on the second day after initial hospital admission.
notes: The deposited investigation describes 133 serum patients split 64 discovery/69 validation, while the linked S3 view reports 134 retained plasma samples from a broader 154-person blood collection; its cohort linkage to the chosen deposit is not established. The cohort also had repeated clinical follow-ups, but that alone does not mean repeated metabolomics sampling.
